description: Everything about a piece of equipment (record equipment-360, or unit): an equipment item with all its units, or one unit. The head (name, class, how many units and where, its picture), each unit now (yard, free / booked / on site / coming back / maintenance, next booking, free in the window), its availability ahead on a compact timeline (Availability's rules and colours), and its full history newest first (bookings, units assigned and released, status changes, transfer orders and moves between projects, inspections, Fusion maintenance work orders, certificates and documents), each entry opening its record. Reads only: resources/js/equipment360.js.

name.description: The equipment item's name (e.g. Komatsu D65EX-18 Dozer).

equipmentId.description: The equipment master's id, when known.

serial.description: One unit's serial: the page opens on that unit.

unit.description: As serial (the unit record's name for it).

key.description: The record's key (unit-<serial> or item-<id or name>), on the page's root as data-key.

uid.description: The key made safe for element ids (the date boxes).

notes.description: What could not be loaded for the units and their availability, in words.

head.description: equipment360.headOf: kicker, title, sub, where, now, facts, image, equipmentId, allText.

model.description: availability.build of these units and bookings (with Fusion's work orders once read).

yards.description: A unit's yard as the views name it, by serial, for a unit whose location is not held.

view.description: equipment360.view: the units and the availability ahead, worked out in one go.

maint.description: Fusion's planned maintenance: none (no maintenance asset) | loading | ready | partial.

hist.description: equipment360.historyOf: every entry newest first, the unit chips, what it is made of and what could not be read.

hv.description: The history as shown: the unit chip and its entries.
